# A point in two-dimensional space.
class Point
  attr_reader :x, :y

  def initialize(x, y)
    @x = x
    @y = y
  end

  # Euclidean distance to +other+.
  def distance_to(other)
    Math.hypot(x - other.x, y - other.y)
  end

  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(Point) && x == other.x && y == other.y
  end
  alias eql? ==

  def hash
    [x, y].hash
  end

  def to_s
    "(#{x}, #{y})"
  end
end
